articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.snippet: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
articles.snippet: The new Lend v2 product turns deposits and borrowed assets into trading liquidity, tying higher returns to whether Jupiter’s router can send enough swap flow to the new vaults.

articles.title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks
articles.snippet: Chairman Tom Lee said easing financial conditions could support crypto, even as the CLARITY Act failed to reach a Senate vote before the August recess.

articles.title: Strategy sells 1,690 bitcoin, raises $653 million from MSTR shares
articles.snippet: The company increased its USD reserve to $4.65 billion while reducing its bitcoin holdings to 840,447 BTC

articles.title: Crypto exchange Coinsbuy loses $8 million in coordinated two-blockchain attack
articles.snippet: Onchain forensics tie a single actor to an $8 million coordinated drain across TRON and Ethereum, with most funds routed through FixedFloat and the attack vector still unknown.
